checks.text: On initial load, the page displays the heading "Classic Tetris", a grid of 10 columns by 20 rows, the text "Score: 0", and the text "Best: 0".
Pressing the key "ArrowLeft" moves the active tetromino one cell to the left; if the tetromino is at the left wall, it does not move.
Pressing the key "ArrowRight" moves the active tetromino one cell to the right; if the tetromino is at the right wall, it does not move.
Pressing the key "ArrowDown" moves the active tetromino one cell down immediately; if the tetromino is on the floor, it locks in place and a new tetromino appears at the top.
Pressing the key "ArrowUp" rotates the active tetromino 90 degrees clockwise; if rotation is blocked by walls or other blocks, the tetromino remains in its original orientation.
When a horizontal line is completely filled with blocks, that line disappears, blocks above it shift down one row, and the text "Score: 100" is displayed (assuming the first line clear).
Clicking the button "Restart" clears the board, resets the text "Score: 0", and spawns a new tetromino at the top center of the grid.
If the best score is 0 and the player clears one line (score becomes 100), the text "Best: 100" is displayed.
Reload keeps the best score: after clearing a line to reach a score of 100, reloading the page displays the text "Best: 100" and "Score: 0".
